## Purpose and Scopesvg image

This document specifies the structure and syntax of HTML context files generated by the Contexter system. HTML context files are single-page HTML documents that package entire project directories with syntax highlighting, styling, and embedded metadata for reconstruction.

For information about the Markdown context format, see [Markdown Context Format](/ray0404/Contexter/7.1-markdown-context-format). For instructions on building HTML contexts, see [buildcontexthtml](/ray0404/Contexter/5.1.2-buildcontexthtml). For reconstructing projects from HTML contexts, see [reconstructorhtml](/ray0404/Contexter/5.2.2-reconstructorhtml).

## Overviewsvg image

HTML context files are self-contained HTML documents that serve as portable project representations. Unlike Markdown contexts, HTML contexts include embedded CSS styling and use Pygments for syntax highlighting, making them immediately viewable in web browsers. The format is designed to be both human-readable and machine-parseable.

**Key characteristics:**

- Single HTML5 document with inline CSS
- Syntax highlighting via Pygments HTML formatter
- Structural metadata encoded in `data-*` attributes
- Preserves exact file content in HTML-escaped format
- Directory tree visualization included
- Binary files marked with special containers

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py180-216](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L180-L216) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py1-61](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L1-L61)

## HTML Document Structuresvg image

HTML context files follow a consistent document structure generated by the `rebuild_html_constructor` function:

**Diagram: HTML Context File DOM Structure**

The document structure includes:

1. Standard HTML5 DOCTYPE declaration
2. `<head>` section with UTF-8 encoding and embedded CSS
3. `<body>` containing a single `.container` div
4. Optional `.tree-container` with directory structure
5. Multiple `.file-container` or `.skipped-container` divs for each file

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py183-216](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L183-L216)

## File Container Formatsvg image

Each file in the project is represented by a `div.file-container` element with specific structural requirements:

### Regular File Containersvg image

**Key attributes and elements:**

| Element/Attribute | Purpose | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data-path` | File path identifier for parsing | `"src/main.py"` |
| `.file-container` | CSS class for styling | Container div |
| `<h2>` header | Human-readable file label | `FILE: src/main.py` |
| `.path` span | Monospace styling for path | Inside header |
| `.highlight` div | Contains syntax-highlighted code | Pygments output |

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py201-212](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L201-L212)

### Binary File Containersvg image

Binary files that cannot be included as text use a simplified container:

**Differences from regular containers:**

- Uses `.skipped-container` class instead of `.file-container`
- Contains only header, no content div
- Uses `<h3>` instead of `<h2>` for visual distinction
- `data-path` attribute still present for reconstruction metadata

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py202-203](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L202-L203)

## Syntax Highlighting Systemsvg image

HTML contexts use Pygments to generate syntax-highlighted code blocks. The highlighting system involves two components:

**Diagram: Syntax Highlighting Pipeline**

### Language Detectionsvg image

The `get_language_from_path` function maps file extensions to Pygments language identifiers:

| File Extension | Language ID | Example Files |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.py` | `python` | main.py, utils.py |
| `.js` | `javascript` | app.js, script.js |
| `.ts` | `typescript` | component.ts |
| `.html` | `html` | index.html |
| `.css` | `css` | styles.css |
| `.json` | `json` | package.json |
| `.md` | `markdown` | README.md |
| `.sh` | `bash` | deploy.sh |

**Special cases:**

- `Dockerfile` (no extension) → `dockerfile`
- `Makefile` (no extension) → `makefile`
- Unknown extensions → extension name without dot
- No extension → `text`

### HTML Formatter Configurationsvg image

The Pygments `HtmlFormatter` is configured with specific options:

**Parameters:**

- `linenos=True`: Generates line numbers in the output
- `cssclass="highlight"`: Wraps output in `<div class="highlight">`

## Embedded CSS Stylingsvg image

HTML context files include a complete CSS stylesheet in the `<head>` section. The styling consists of two parts:

### Custom Stylesheetsvg image

**Key classes:**

| Class | Applied To | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.container` | Main wrapper div | Centers content, max width 1200px |
| `.file-container` | File content blocks | Border, shadow, spacing |
| `.skipped-container` | Binary file markers | Same styling as file containers |
| `.tree-container` | Directory tree | Same styling as file containers |
| `.path` | File path text | Monospace font, red color |
| `.highlight` | Code blocks | Reset margins, enable scroll |

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py185-192](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L185-L192)

### Pygments Stylesheetsvg image

The Pygments CSS is dynamically generated for the 'default' style:

This generates CSS rules for syntax highlighting tokens like:

- `.highlight .k` - Keywords
- `.highlight .nf` - Function names
- `.highlight .s2` - String literals
- `.highlight .linenos` - Line numbers
- And many more token types

The complete Pygments CSS is injected into the `<style>` block in the document head.

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py182-193](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L182-L193)

## Directory Tree Sectionsvg image

HTML contexts optionally include a directory tree visualization at the beginning of the document:

**Tree generation:**

- Created by `generate_file_tree` function in [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py41-65](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L41-L65)
- Uses box-drawing characters: `│`, `├──`, `└──`
- Respects exclusion patterns (excludes hidden files, build artifacts, etc.)
- Directories shown with trailing `/`
- Files and directories sorted alphabetically
- HTML-escaped in output to preserve formatting

**Conditional inclusion:**

- Tree is only included if `tree_content` parameter is provided to `rebuild_html_constructor`
- Built by `buildcontexthtml` when processing directories
- Not included when building from individual files

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py196-199](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L196-L199) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py33-57](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L33-L57)

## Parsing and Data Attributessvg image

The `parse_html_constructor` function extracts file data from HTML contexts by querying specific DOM elements and attributes:

**Diagram: HTML Context Parsing Algorithm**

### Parsing Logicsvg image

The parser performs two main queries:

**1. Regular file containers:**

**2. Binary file containers:**

**Output format:**

| File Type | Dictionary Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text file | String content | Extracted from `.highlight` div |
| Binary file | `None` | Marker for skipped file |
| Missing path | Not included | Invalid container skipped |

**Critical requirements:**

- `data-path` attribute must be present on container div
- `.highlight` div must exist within `.file-container` for content extraction
- Binary files marked explicitly with `None` value (not empty string)
- Text content extracted via `.get_text()` method (strips HTML tags)

## Cross-Format Compatibilitysvg image

HTML context files maintain compatibility with the patch and update system, enabling cross-format operations:

**Diagram: Cross-Format Update Operations**

**Supported operations:**

1. Generate HTML patch from two HTML contexts
2. Generate Markdown patch from two HTML contexts
3. Apply HTML patch to HTML context
4. Apply Markdown patch to HTML context (cross-format)

## Format Validation Requirementssvg image

For an HTML file to be considered a valid Contexter HTML context file:

**Required elements:**

- HTML5 DOCTYPE declaration
- UTF-8 character encoding
- At least one `.file-container` or `.skipped-container` div
- Each container must have a `data-path` attribute
- File containers must have a `.highlight` div with content
- Skipped containers must indicate binary files

**Optional elements:**

- Directory tree section (`.tree-container`)
- Custom CSS styling (can be omitted)
- Pygments stylesheet (required for proper rendering)

**Invalid conditions:**

- Missing `data-path` attributes (files cannot be reconstructed)
- File containers without `.highlight` div (content lost)
- Malformed HTML structure (parsing fails)
- Non-unique file paths (reconstruction conflict)

The parser is lenient and uses BeautifulSoup's HTML5 parser, which handles minor formatting issues, but structural requirements must be met for successful reconstruction.

Sources: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py111-129](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L111-L129) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md30-31](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L30-L31)
